reviewer: Wasteland author: independent initial review of root-owned legacy and billboard art, followed by explicitly delegated narrow cleanup
scope: 25 prior legacy assemblies and 25 new billboard assemblies. Initial review was read-only. Root subsequently authorized this reviewer to remove only zero-area legacy runtime triangles and add two ambulance headlamp pedestals; all other corrections belong to their original authors. Two authorized sign source-part metadata counts were corrected.
method: All 50 final model renders visually inspected in ten final contact sheets, followed by the fresh ambulance render after its final pedestals. All 9,290 editable component bounds examined with source-code support relationships; runtime and editable component zero-area checks repeated after the final support and hidden-web corrections. Bounds adjacency at 25 mm is a screening check, not proof of attachment; concrete repair closure also uses actual source positions and render inspection.
limitations: No gameplay collision or performance claim; root owns native runtime and final profiling. Closed form whole-model ground bounds do not prove every subcomponent supported.
